name: Pirate Hats Ahoy!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully champion. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society.  Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the Horde calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style.  And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part.

So here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. Do you think you can handle that?
narrative.objectives: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh you're a darling, even if it did take you longer than I am accustomed to. This shipment should make me quite a bit of money once I've cleaned and personalized these hats. And seeing as I'm always willing to reward work that's well done, here's a little something for you. I suggest that you spend some of it on a bath sweetie.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have all 20 hats? I don't believe you, let me see them. They better be in pristine condition!
